column1: # The 74 scalars stage A (group SG) placed inside [[block]] records: each is a field of the
# record family, marked field_of / field_offset in symbols.toml (tools/gen_symbols.py). Stage C1's
# struct names the field; the entry goes once its sites read the struct (docs/typed-data-stage-c.md 5).
# Two of the 74 (0x93BABC, 0x93BAE0) lie in the 0x80-byte sprite object between two EnemyWorkingRecords
# records: fields of BattleEnemy 1 (0x93B960 + 0x128 n), which has no [[block]], so they are not marked.
# readers_typed: files spelling the entry's typed macro; readers_addr: files spelling only <name>_addr.
